evals.prompt: Generate a markdown evaluation report from the assessment data in data/assessor/.
evals.expected_output: A comprehensive markdown report is generated with per-applicant summaries and aggregate statistics.
assertions: evaluation_report.md exists in the output directory
Per-applicant summary.md files exist for each applicant

evals.prompt: Generate an Excel summary from assessment data.
evals.expected_output: An Excel file is created with scores, statistics, and proper formatting.
assertions: evaluation_summary.xlsx exists in the output directory
Excel file has at least one sheet with data rows
All applicant IDs appear in the spreadsheet

evals.prompt: Verify data coverage when one applicant is missing an evaluation.
evals.expected_output: Verification detects the missing evaluation and reports it.
assertions: Report lists the missing applicant ID
